goal: Give Product, Solutions, Pricing, and Resources distinct purposeful pages
context: P2 begins after Landing and Admin acceptance. Keep existing route behavior and shared visual language without reusing one generic page template as a substitute for separate experiences.
requirements: Confirm routes for Product, Solutions, Pricing, and Resources load independently and the main navigation links to each exact destination
Give Product a capability/product-proof story; Solutions a use-case/industry story; Pricing a scannable plan comparison and CTA; Resources an editorial library layout
Maintain shared typography, color, spacing, buttons, footer, and responsive navigation while allowing distinct page composition
Use truthful product claims and working internal links; avoid decorative card grids without useful information
acceptance_criteria: All four pages load directly and via navigation with no missing/static 404 route
Each page has a unique purpose, hierarchy, body content, and appropriate CTA rather than only swapped labels
Desktop/mobile layouts are checked for overflow, accessible focus, and visual consistency
